content:
Choose the 2 brands that will occupy same-brand garages: \(\binom{4}{2}=6\).

Choose the 2 garages for these brands: \(\binom{4}{2}=6\).

Assign the 2 chosen brands to the 2 chosen garages: \(2!=2\).

The remaining 2 garages are then forced to contain one car of each of the remaining 2 brands: \(1\) way.

Total: \(6 \cdot 6 \cdot 2 = 72\).

\[
\boxed{72}
\]
